body:
Objective: Commit and push current SEO changes to the repository remote.
Context: Current changes update `src/lib/structured-data.ts` identifiers to `ktappdev` and `src/pages/index.astro` homepage title/subtitle to include `ktappdev`. Builder previously confirmed `pnpm build` and `git diff --check` pass.
Constraints: Inspect git status/diff first. Commit only these intended changes. Do not amend unrelated work, force-push, or alter files. Push current branch to its configured upstream.
Action steps:
1. Run git status and git diff --stat/diff.
2. Commit with a concise message such as `feat: add ktappdev SEO identity`.
3. Push to upstream.
4. Report commit hash, branch, push result, and any issue.
Deliverables: commit/push confirmation via picode_send.
